pm.test("Instancia UP en puerto 8081", () => { const app=pm.response.json().application; pm.expect(app.name).to.eql("MS-DUENO"); pm.expect(app.instance.some(i => i.status === "UP" && i.port["$"] === 8081)).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Servicio, MySQL y Config Server UP", () => { const health=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(health.status).to.eql("UP"); pm.expect(health.components.db.status).to.eql("UP"); pm.expect(health.components.db.details.database).to.eql("MySQL"); pm.expect(health.components.clientConfigServer.status).to.eql("UP"); });

pm.test("Nombre, descripción y versión", () => { const app=pm.response.json().app; pm.expect(app.name).to.eql("ms-dueno"); pm.expect(app.description).to.include("Patitas Felices"); pm.expect(app.version).to.eql("1.0.0"); });

pm.test("Configuración remota activa y valores ocultos", () => { const sources=pm.response.json().propertySources; pm.expect(sources.some(p => p.name.includes("configserver:") && p.properties["patitas.config-source"])).to.eql(true); for (const source of sources) { for (const property of Object.values(source.properties)) { if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(property,"value")) pm.expect(property.value).to.eql("******"); } } });

pm.test("Cinco operaciones CRUD documentadas", () => { const paths = pm.response.json().paths; pm.expect(paths["/api/duenos"]).to.have.keys("get", "post"); pm.expect(paths["/api/duenos/{id}"]).to.have.keys("get", "put", "delete"); });
